description: Team Stellar Forge, representing the Thrissur local event, is addressing the challenge "Flame in Freefall: AI-Powered Fire Safety Insights from Microgravity Combustion Data." Our team is led by a third-year Mechanical Engineering student with expertise in CAD and thermal systems. We seek members skilled in data analysis, programming, artificial intelligence and machine learning, and data visualization. Members with communication or multimedia skills are also welcome.
